Textbooks and reference courses

Selected English-language materials for studying dynamic programming, reinforcement learning and modern applications.

Core reading

DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING

Dynamic Programming and Optimal Control

Dimitri P. Bertsekas, Volume I. The main reference for modeling, the principle of optimality and classical DP.

Author's book page →

REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction

Richard S. Sutton and Andrew G. Barto, second edition. The main reference for tabular learning, approximation and policy gradients.

Official book website →

A UNIFIED VIEW

Reinforcement Learning and Stochastic Optimization

Warren B. Powell. A complementary framework for modeling sequential decisions across applications.

Author's book website →
